description: The Federal Reserve's rate decisions from its own record: each FOMC meeting of a year (held and scheduled), the action, change and target range, the vote with dissenters and their reasons, links to statements and minutes, the latest statement, and the median projections (dot plot) for GDP, unemployment, inflation and the federal funds rate.

year.description: Meetings and decisions of this year; default this year.

name: fomc

outputSchema.description: rows are the year's meetings in date order, in the order of columns: target range in percent, change in basis points; projections has the median paths.
